# dr_flac

A FLAC decoder by David Reid, <https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs>, public
domain or MIT No Attribution, as you choose (see `LICENSE`). Only
`dr_flac.h` (v0.13.5) is included, unchanged, from commit
`e381981afa52800b9a3864df548353ff67252fbc`. Reluva uses it through
`src/audio/compressed.cpp` (FLAC files, such as CD tracks ripped to them).
